device.name: Harvard Apparatus Microliter OEM syringe pump (pymupump.Microliter)

facts.text: pymupump controls a Harvard Apparatus Microliter OEM syringe pump
A Chain is created on a serial port and a Microliter is created on that chain
A second pump on the same port is selected by its address
The syringe diameter is in mm and the README states the range 0.1 - 4.61 mm
The flow rate is set in uL/min
The infuse or withdraw target volume is in uL
The README example runs infuse or withdraw, optionally waits for the target volume, and stops the pump
Chain opens a serial line with two stop bits, no parity and a 2 s timeout
The pump address is formatted as two zero-padded digits
A command is written as the pump address, the command text and a carriage return
The constructor queries VER, reads 17 bytes and checks the two characters before the last against the address
diameter, flowrate and targetvolume start as None
The clone states the syringe diameter range as 0.1-4.61 mm and says the pump ignores precision beyond two decimal places
setdiameter rounds to three decimal places and rejects a diameter above 4.61 or below 0.1 mm
setdiameter sends MMD and checks the set value with DIA
setflowrate takes microlitres per minute
The clone says the accepted flow rate depends on the syringe diameter and the pump reports an out-of-range rate
setflowrate sends ULM and ULMW and checks the values with RAT and RATW
An out-of-range flow rate is reported as OOR
infuse sends RUN and requires the forward-running '>' status character
withdraw sends RUNW and requires the backward-running '<' status character
stop sends STP without waiting for a reply and requires one of ':*IWDT'
settargetvolume clears the four target settings with CLT, CLTW, CLV and CLVW, then sends ULT and ULTW
settargetvolume stores the target volume in microlitres
waituntiltarget polls VOL while the reply carries '<' or '>'
